title: Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent
abstract: arXiv:2610.35616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Skills provide agents with reusable experience to guide future decisions without modifying the underlying model. However, coding trajectories are often entangled with task- and repository-specific contexts, making it challenging to distill procedural skills that generalize across diverse coding environments. To address this challenge, we present Hierarchical Skill Evolution (HSE), which progressively distills procedural knowledge from coding trajectories through hierarchical evidence aggregation. HSE first extracts task-level evidence from individual trajectories, then aggregates recurring evidence within the same repository to form repository-specific skill candidates, and finally consolidates consistent patterns across repositories into transferable skills across repositories. translated_title: 面向编程智能体的分层技能演化
translated_abstract: 技能为智能体提供可复用的经验，能够在不修改底层模型的情况下指导未来决策。然而，编程轨迹往往与任务及代码仓库特定的上下文纠缠在一起，这使得提炼出能够在多样化编程环境中泛化的程序性技能变得极具挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了分层技能演化，通过分层证据聚合从编程轨迹中逐步提炼程序性知识。HSE 首先从单个轨迹中提取任务级证据，然后在同一仓库内聚合重复出现的证据以形成仓库特定的技能候选，最后将跨仓库一致的模式整合为可跨仓库迁移的技能。该演化过程由一个外部的书写-评估循环驱动，在保持底层编程模型冻结的同时生成并评估技能。
tldr: 提出分层技能演化（HSE）方法，通过任务级、仓库级到跨仓库的分层证据聚合，从编程轨迹中逐步提炼可跨仓库迁移的程序性技能，并借助外部书写-评估循环在冻结底层模型的情况下驱动技能生成与评估。
en_tdlr: We propose Hierarchical Skill Evolution (HSE), which progressively distills transferable procedural skills from coding trajectories via hierarchical evidence aggregation from task to repository to cross-repository levels, driven by an external writer-evaluator loop while keeping the underlying coding model frozen.
